narr: A cold front triggered showers and scattered thunderstorms. Locally heavy rain from thunderstorms led to isolated instances of flooding and flash flooding in the northern Shenandoah Valley.
ev: The gauge at New Market along the Smith Creek rose above flood stage of 8 feet, cresting at 9.45 feet at 8 PM EST. The water level fell below flood stage at 10:23 PM EST on the 24th. Mount Airy Lane was flooded and Route 826 was also flooded. Agricultural flooding also took place near Smith Creek.
lsr: NORTH FORK SHENANDOAH RIVER AT NEW MARKET ROSE RAPIDLY REACHING MINOR FLOOD STAGE IN LESS THAN 3 HOURS.
